# Grizzlybit — Zubair Ahmed

> Personal portfolio and engineering blog of Zubair Ahmed (Grizzlybit), full-stack software engineer and Chief Technology Officer at RAZRLAB. Based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Focus areas: Node.js, React, TypeScript, Next.js, IoT, fleet management, mobile (Ionic), Linux, and cloud architecture.

## Portfolio case studies

- [Vehicle Tracking Application](https://www.grizzlybit.dev/portfolio/vehicle-tracking): Real-time fleet management web app — React, Node.js, RabbitMQ, Redis, Leaflet, OSRM. Recognized by Dubai Police.
- [Vehicle Tracking Mobile App](https://www.grizzlybit.dev/portfolio/vehicle-tracking-mobile): Ionic/TypeScript mobile companion for fleet ops.
- [COVID-19 Patient Tracker](https://www.grizzlybit.dev/portfolio/covid-tracker): Remote health monitoring with BLE oxygen meter integration.
- [My247](https://www.grizzlybit.dev/portfolio/my247-app): App for UK's 4th-largest boiler service company.
- [MyCarlo](https://www.grizzlybit.dev/portfolio/mycarlo-app): Consumer vehicle telematics and family safety product.
- [Smart Boiler Mobile](https://www.grizzlybit.dev/portfolio/boiler-mobile): Remote thermostat / boiler control.
- [Heavy Equipment Monitoring](https://www.grizzlybit.dev/portfolio/he-app): Construction-industry heavy-equipment telemetry dashboard.
- [Worldly Pins](https://www.grizzlybit.dev/portfolio/worldly-pins): Traveller utility app.
- [Grizzly Tools](https://www.grizzlybit.dev/portfolio/tools-grizzly): Collection of developer utilities.
- [TIS Landing Page](https://www.grizzlybit.dev/portfolio/tis-landing-page): Marketing site for a Dubai thermal-insulation company.
